newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Beter Bed issue price set at 25-28 guilders.
newsitem.headline: Beter Bed issue price set at 25-28 guilders.

text.p: Beter Bed Holding NV's initial public offering will be priced at 25 to 28 guilders per share, ABN AMRO said on Monday.
ABN AMRO said the announcement of the definitive price, the allocation and bourse listing were all set for December 5, 1996.
ABN AMRO said the offering would consist of 3.65 million existing shares plus a maximum of 400,000 newly issued shares.
The existing shares represented 60.9 percent of the current share capital, while the new represent an increase of up to 6.67 percent of the current share capital.
Institutional investors were invited to subscribe through the bookbuilding system, under which they say how many shares they are willing to buy and at what price.
Private investors were invited to subscribe through the open price system, under which they are invited to subscribe at the price set under the book building process.
